newsitem.title: USA: Boston Scientific skids after analyst mtg.
newsitem.headline: Boston Scientific skids after analyst mtg.

text.p: Boston Scientific Corp stock slid almost seven percent Wednesday in a vigorous selloff brought on by the company's remarks in a meeting with analysts, market sources said.
The tumble began at midday and over the next 30 minutes, the shares dropped to a session-low 48-1/2 from 54-1/4, then recovered slightly to trade at 50-1/2, off 3-3/4.

No one at the company was available to comment and many of the analysts following the company were in Boston attending the presentation, though the offices of two analysts said they were revisiting earnings projections for possible reductions.
"They (the company) said it is going to take time to work out of expenses they have incurred," one of the sources said.
